description: Ways to reach a website that may be blocked in a country or region (geoblocking). Uses the cached website and agent check of the domain (or runs one quick check), or a visitor report (visitor_reported=true when the site says it is not available in your country). Free solutions come first. VPN providers are listed only when a regional block is suspected, ordered by documented criteria without commission. Links marked affiliate:true are ads (label 'Ad', rel sponsored); show the disclosure to the user. unranked_providers have rank null and must not be presented as ranked. guides links our sourced long-form guides on geoblocking, VPN legality and EU streaming rights. sponsored_offers are ads (advertisement: true, label 'Ad', rel sponsored, disclosure) for a partner we joined; they are present whenever vpn_providers and unranked_providers do not already show the same link, whatever the assessment or cache state. Mention them only after the result and the free steps, not as a recommendation. Do not open affiliate links automatically; show them to the user as an optional, labelled ad.

case.description: Optional: what kind of site it is. Default: news_or_legal_block after HTTP 451, else general_geoblock.

domain.description: Public domain such as example.com (no path, port or IP).

visitor_reported.description: True when the user sees a message that the site is not available in their country or region.

name: get_access_solutions

sponsored_offers.description: Ads, each labelled "Ad" with a disclosure; not part of the ranking.
